security_audit.summary: The skill is mostly legitimate PDF tooling, but the audit confirmed an unsafe eval example, privileged installation commands, predictable temporary-file examples, and helper functions that write to caller-provided paths. Most code-fence, import, reconnaissance, URL, and documentation-only output matches were false positives. No prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Unsafe eval in invoice CSV example
remediation.suggestion: Replace eval(row['items']) with json.loads or ast.literal_eval and document the expected CSV format.
Remove automatic sudo guidance from agent-facing instructions and require explicit human approval for system package installation.
Use tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile or tempfile.TemporaryDirectory instead of fixed paths under /tmp.
Validate output paths, warn before overwriting existing files, and prefer a user-approved output directory.

content.value_statement: PDF work often requires several libraries and careful file handling. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through extraction, creation, forms, OCR, and common PDF operations.
actual_capabilities: Extracts text and tables with pypdf and pdfplumber guidance.
Creates PDFs with ReportLab examples for reports, invoices, tables, and images.
Merges, splits, rotates, watermarks, annotates, encrypts, decrypts, and optimizes PDFs.
Fills and inspects PDF form fields with PyMuPDF examples.
Runs OCR workflows for scanned PDFs with pdf2image and pytesseract.
Provides helper functions for common local PDF workflows.
limitations: Requires Python packages and optional system tools for OCR and image conversion.
Reads and writes local files, so users must review input and output paths.
OCR quality depends on scan quality, language packs, and installed engines.
Does not provide cloud storage, hosted processing, or document review services.

use_cases.title: Extract Contract Text
use_cases.description: Pull readable text and tables from contracts for review, search, or migration.

use_cases.title: Prepare Monthly Reports
use_cases.description: Create formatted PDF reports from business metrics, charts, and narrative sections.

use_cases.title: Build PDF Utilities
use_cases.description: Use Python helpers to merge, split, rotate, watermark, encrypt, and inspect PDFs.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract all readable text from document.pdf. Preserve page breaks and summarize any pages with little or no text.

prompt_templates.title: Read Tables
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract tables from report.pdf into CSV files. Tell me which pages contained tables and flag rows that need manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Edit and Combine
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge these PDFs in order, rotate page 3 of the result, add page numbers, and save the final file in the approved output folder.

prompt_templates.title: Automate OCR Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workflow for scanned_invoice.pdf that runs OCR, extracts text, saves a searchable PDF, and reports any low-confidence pages.

output_examples.input: Extract text and tables from a quarterly report PDF.
output_examples.output: A page-by-page text summary, a list of detected tables, and CSV files for each table.

output_examples.input: Merge five policy PDFs and add a confidential watermark.
output_examples.output: One combined PDF with the requested watermark and a short note listing source order and page count.

output_examples.input: Run OCR on a scanned invoice packet.
output_examples.output: Extracted invoice text, a searchable PDF copy, and a warning for pages that may need manual correction.

best_practices: Confirm file paths before reading, writing, merging, or deleting PDFs.
Use secure temporary-file APIs for intermediate PDF and image files.
Validate PDFs and handle encrypted or scanned documents before processing.
anti_patterns: Do not run eval on PDF, CSV, form, or metadata input.
Do not execute sudo installation commands without explicit human approval.
Do not write outputs to broad or shared directories without overwrite checks.

faq.question: Can this skill extract text from scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides OCR workflows using pdf2image and pytesseract when normal text extraction returns little content.

faq.question: Can it fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. The references show how to inspect fields, fill values, update widgets, and save filled PDFs.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents required Python and system dependencies, but users should approve every installation command.

faq.question: Can it merge and split PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples and helper functions for merging, page ranges, splitting, rotation, and page operations.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive documents?
faq.answer: It works on local files, but users must control paths, permissions, temporary files, and access to source documents.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
